Not sure how to structure a university essay? Markers notice the shape of your argument before the details 📝

✅ Unpack the question first: "discuss", "evaluate" and "to what extent" each ask for something different
✅ Write a one-sentence answer (your thesis) before you start reading
✅ Plan the split: about 10% introduction, 80% main body, 10% conclusion
✅ Build each paragraph with PEEL: Point, Evidence, Explanation, Link
✅ Do not add new points or sources in the conclusion

Free guide with a full PEEL example: fizbusinessolutions.com/blog/how-to-structure-a-university-essay

posts.caption:
Findings chapter done? The discussion answers the question every marker asks: so what? 🎯

Discuss each key finding in 5 steps:
1️⃣ Finding: state the result briefly
2️⃣ Meaning: what it tells you about your research question
3️⃣ Literature: compare it with specific studies from your review
4️⃣ Explanation: why your result agrees or differs
5️⃣ Implication: what follows for theory or practice

Free guide with a chapter structure, an example paragraph and useful phrases: fizbusinessolutions.com/blog/how-to-write-a-dissertation-discussion

Academic proofreading for essays, dissertations and theses

Small slips add up. Spelling errors, mixed referencing styles and overlong sentences can distract markers from your ideas. FIZ Business Solutions (FIZBS) has supported university students in the UK and Saudi Arabia since 2015, and polishing finished drafts is one of our most common requests.

Your document is checked by a Master's or PhD qualified expert who understands academic writing in your field. Every edit is made with tracked changes in Microsoft Word, so you can see each change and accept or reject it. Where a sentence is unclear, your expert adds a comment instead of guessing.

What we check: grammar, spelling, punctuation, UK or US English, academic tone, formatting, and whether your in-text citations match your reference list.

Prices per 1,000 words (7+ day deadlines): £12 undergraduate, £15 postgraduate, £18 PhD. New students get 10% off the first order, and you pay 50% to start and 50% on completion.
